subject: Trainee Civil Drafter application, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello TTW team,

I'm applying for the Trainee Civil Drafter role in your North Sydney office that I saw on SEEK.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019), and from 2019 to 2020 I worked on site there as a field engineer and project-in-charge, reviewing drawings against project requirements.

Your advert offers a three year drafting traineeship with mentoring across your drafting software, which is exactly where I want to build my career. I'm based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Sydney. I hold a White Card and full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I haven't used AutoTURN on a job yet, so I would start as a trainee.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.company_line: TTW is a locally owned consulting engineering firm of over 550 staff across six offices in Australia and Asia, consulting for more than 65 years.
letter.subject: Trainee Civil Drafter, North Sydney
paragraphs: I am applying for the Trainee Civil Drafter role in your North Sydney office advertised on SEEK. A three year traineeship with mentoring across your drafting software on projects for high profile clients is the drafting career I want to build.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, applying Australian Standards, and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings against project requirements, carried out site inspections and quality checks, and prepared site and progress reports, which showed me how drawings are used in the field.

I hold a White Card and full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Sydney. I have not yet used AutoTURN on a job or drafted in a consulting office, so I would start as a trainee and learn your standards quickly.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
